API reference

The DRAFT forecasting tool provides an end-to-end pipeline from experimental specifications to projected parameter constraints, covering foreground modeling, sky masking, ILC-based component separation, delensing and the Fisher-matrix calculation. The pipeline as a whole is described in §3.4 of arXiv:2608.07453, with the underlying formalism in §3.1 to §3.3.

All these pipeline stages are implemented in this repository. The delensing and the Fisher-matrix calculation are carried out by two companion codes, which DRAFT drives rather than reimplements. See Installation for how to build them.

Note

The pages below are currently maintained by hand, with each module described by its own module docstring. Do not regenerate them with sphinx-apidoc.

Inputs

exp_specs module

Experimental specifications for each survey configuration: frequency bands, beam widths \(\theta_b\), white-noise levels \(\Delta_{T,P}\) and the atmospheric (\(1/f\)) parameters \(\ell_\mathrm{knee}\) and \(\alpha_\mathrm{knee}\). Also covers the Planck configurations whose inverse-variance-combined noise enters the forecast (§2.1 of arXiv:2608.07453).

foregrounds module

Galactic dust and synchrotron power spectra obtained from pySM3 simulations, and the extragalactic CIB, radio, tSZ and kSZ templates (§3.1 of arXiv:2608.07453).

The fiducial cosmology, the parameter step sizes for the numerical derivatives and the foreground configuration are read from params.ini.

Component separation

get_ilc_residuals module

Driver for this stage. Assembles the per-band beams and noise levels for a named configuration, applies the galactic mask, builds the covariance, runs the ILC and writes the residual power spectra \(C_\ell^\mathrm{res}\) to a product file.

ilc module

The multi-frequency covariance \(\mathbf{C}_\ell\) of the noise and foreground spectra, the ILC weights and the residual power. Supports the minimum-variance, constrained and partial variants (§3.2 of arXiv:2608.07453).

misc module

Supporting calculations: beam transfer functions \(B_\ell\), noise power spectra \(N_\ell\) from the experimental specifications, parameter file I/O and map-domain utilities.

The data location for the galactic foregrounds and the values of the template parameters for the extragalactic foregrounds are read from params.ini.

Forecasting

get_fisher_forecasts module

Driver for this stage. Reads one or more ILC products, treats each survey and sky patch as an independent experiment whose Fisher matrices are summed, drives the delensing and the Fisher-matrix calculation, and writes the forecast together with the projected parameter uncertainties.

delensing module

Iterative delensing. Combines the residual spectra with the effective Planck noise and hands the result to CLASS_delens, which reconstructs the lensing potential and returns the delensed spectra together with the lensing-reconstruction noise \(N_\ell^{dd}\).

fisher module

The Fisher matrix \(F_{\alpha\beta}\) for one survey configuration and the separate large-scale contribution from a satellite, reduced to the projected uncertainties \(\sigma(p_\alpha)\).

Both companion codes are reached through FisherLens, a git submodule of this repository which brings CLASS_delens as a submodule of its own (§3.3 of arXiv:2608.07453).

The fiducial cosmology, the parameter step sizes, the multipole ranges, the priors and the option flags are read from params_fisher.ini.

Utilities

flatsky module

Flat-sky simulation and power-spectrum estimation, used for small patches in the flat-sky approximation. Not part of the forecasting pipeline.
